{{Quote|Right, Artoo! We've gotta find a way to ''sneak'' past those fighters and ''warn'' the base.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Maarka" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''skirmish''' took place in an [[Unidentified asteroid field (Maarka)|asteroid field]] near [[Maarka]].

==The skirmish==
While on a mission to deliver a [[Datafile/Legends|data file]] with important intelligence for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Maarka Republic base|base]] on [[Maarka]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was ambushed by six [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] in an [[Unidentified asteroid field (Maarka)|asteroid field]]. Losing one of the two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|her]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], she nonetheless managed to destroy her pursuers with a single shot on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], causing it to move and crash onto the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]].

Ahsoka Tano then proceeded with her mission, delivering the data file to the Maarka base and later meeting with the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim.]]
